report.banner: SYNTHETIC TEST — NOT REAL TRAFFIC EVIDENCE
state_history: observation-only -> candidate disruption: current/free-flow below 0.5 with confidence ≥ 0.7 on 2 valid cycles
candidate disruption -> resolving: first valid normal cycle
resolving -> closed: 2 successive valid normal cycles (provisional recovery rule)
limits: Detects road conditions only. Cannot prove a named motorist tried to leave, had no alternative, overstayed because of disruption, or is entitled to PCN cancellation.
Thresholds are provisional synthetic-test values, not validated alert rules.
